title: SII Vol. 20 No. 2 — Hirebidri
location_detail: On a stone fixed in the gate-way of the Kallesvara temple
date_text: The inscription, in characters of about the 7th century A.D., records the gift of land my Marakona of Guppara (Gupta?) family

title: SII Vol. 20 No. 3 — Lakshmesvara
location_detail: On a slab fixed in the left wall of the samkha-basti at Basti-Bana
summary: It registers a gift of 500 nivarttanas of land to the north of Puligere-nagara, for the worship of and offerings to the God Samkha-Jinendra, by Durgasakti, son of Kundasakti and grand son of Vijayasakti, of the Sendra lineage

title: SII Vol. 20 No. 4 — Lakshmesvar
location_detail: On a slab built into the right wall of the Samkha-basti at Basti-Banu
summary: The record is dated Saka 608, 5th regnal year of the king, Pausha, Paurnima

title: SII Vol. 20 No. 5 — Lakshmesvar
location_detail: On a slab built into the right wall of the Samkha-basti at Bati-Bana
summary: This is dated in Saka 645, the 28th regnal year of the king, Bhadrapada, Paurnima, lunar eclipse, corresponding to A.D. 723, August 20, which was a Friday

title: SII Vol. 20 No. 6 — Lakshmesvar
summary: Slab built into the right wall of the Samkha-basti at Basti-Bana

title: SII Vol. 20 No. 7 — Lakshmesvar
location_detail: On a slab fixed into the left wall of the Samkha-basti at Basti-Bana
summary: The inscription is dated in Saka 656, second regnal year of the king, Magha, Paurnima, corresponding to A.D.735, January 13, which was Thursday

title: SII Vol. 20 No. 8 — Sidenur
location_detail: On a hero-stone set up near the Kallesvara temple
date_text: The record, in characters of about the 8th century A.D., refers to some attack and states that Singa-Vaddagi Rapamman made the Sirivalla

title: SII Vol. 20 No. 9 — Adur
location_detail: On a stone standing on the top of a hill survey
